items.t: Crankshaft position sensor can crack and stall the engine (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Rear trailing arms rust and can break (recall)
items.note: Price is per side. Check your VIN; the recall replaces rusted arms free.

items.t: Front coil springs rust and snap (recall)
items.note: The recall inspects and replaces broken springs free. Check your VIN first.

items.t: ABS kicks in at low speed and lengthens stops (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Passenger airbag sensor may treat a child as an adult (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Fuel tank may leak (recall)
items.note: The recall inspects the tank and replaces it if needed. Check your VIN first.

items.t: ABS module can short from moisture (recall)
items.job: Install ABS power relay per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. If the ABS module itself failed, expect much more.

items.t: Brake light switch fails (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Driver airbag clock spring can fail (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Passenger airbag sensing needs recalibration (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Trailer hitch wiring module can overheat (recall)
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong from failed level sensors
items.note: Price covers both sensors, which are usually done together since the rear seat must come out.

items.t: Misaligned intermediate shaft can wear the transmission (recall)
items.job: Replace transmission output gear and intermediate shaft
items.note: Free under the recall. If the transmission is already damaged, expect much more.

items.t: Rear brake calipers can leak fluid (recall)
items.note: Price is per side. Free under the recall; check your VIN first.

items.t: Rod bearing wear on the 2.4L four-cylinder
items.note: Often covered by the recall and extended engine warranty if the knock-sensor update was done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Engine bearing failure and seizure
items.note: Often covered by recall or lifetime engine warranty if the knock-sensor update was done. Check your VIN.

items.t: High-pressure fuel pipe may leak after engine repair (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: ABS control module fire risk (recall)
items.note: Price is the free recall fuse fix. If the ABS module is damaged, expect much more.

items.t: Right front axle shaft can break (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Hood latch can rust and let the hood fly open (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Seat belt warning may not work (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Steering wheel may come loose (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Side curtain airbags can be damaged when they deploy (recall)
items.job: Install covers over side airbag mounting bolts
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Oil consumption on the 2.4L direct-injection engine
items.note: Dealers run an oil use test first. Keep oil change records; warranty or bulletin may cover it.

items.t: Tow hitch wiring module fire risk (recall)
items.job: Install fuse and wiring kit for tow hitch module
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Fuel line connection may leak (recall)
items.job: Tighten or replace fuel pipe connection
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Passenger airbag may not switch off for a child seat (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Transmission oil pump fault can cause power loss (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Many SUVs only need the inspection and software update.

items.t: Turbo oil supply pipe can crack (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Rearview camera image may not appear (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: SUV may roll away in Park (recall)
items.note: Free over-the-air or dealer update. Check your VIN.

items.t: Floor wiring can chafe and affect airbags (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair floor wiring harness
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Backup camera image missing or blocked (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Starter terminal cover can let the starter short (recall)
items.job: Inspect and reinstall starter terminal cover
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Connecting rod bolts may be loose (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall and new car warranty. Check your VIN.

items.t: Side curtain airbags may be installed wrong (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Front seat belt anchors may detach (recall)
items.job: Reinforce or replace front seat belt anchors
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Instrument panel display may go blank (recall)
items.note: Free over-the-air or dealer update. Check your VIN.

items.t: Tire information label does not meet the standard (recall 03V-520)
items.note: Was free under recall 03V-520. Check the VIN with a dealer.

items.t: Windshield may not be glued in properly (recall 21V-00M)
items.job: Remove and reinstall windshield with new adhesive
items.note: Free under recall 21V-00M. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Crankshaft surface defect can wear the V6 bearings (recall 17V-578)
items.job: Inspect engine bearings, replace engine if damaged
items.note: Free under recall 17V-578. Check the VIN first.
